---
description: "Review a blog post or draft with Squad for grounded writing, metadata, links, and publication readiness."
agent: "Squad"
argument-hint: "Post path or draft to review"
---

Review the post or draft identified by the user. If none is identifiable from the request or editor context,
ask for the path. Follow the [repo instructions](../copilot-instructions.md) and
[routing](../../.squad/routing.md). Verbal owns this review.

Check clarity, structure, front matter, local image and internal link targets, and consistency with supplied
technical evidence. Name tools precisely. Never invent Marcus's experiences, emotions, opinions, results,
or motivations. Mark unsupported claims for confirmation rather than rewriting them as facts.

Preserve published dates and URLs. Do not edit the post unless requested. Do not generate imagery,
promotion copy, issues, commits, or publications automatically. Involve Hockney only for concrete
rendering/test risks and fact-checker only when evidence needs verification.

Return specific findings with file references, any checks run, and the remaining publication blockers.
